label: Temperature alert on WhatsApp
info: Tells you on WhatsApp when a temperature goes above a limit and when it is back to normal.

name: START HERE: setup in 3 steps (select this note)
info:
**Setup in 3 steps** (once, about five minutes)

1. **Link your WhatsApp number.** In the [Turbo Notify dashboard](https://dashboard.turbonotify.com) create an account if you have none (it is free), then open **Numbers** and connect your WhatsApp number. First time? Follow the [step by step guide](https://docs.turbonotify.com/en/guides/quickstart/).
2. **Create an API key.** Open **API keys** and create one with the **AI agent (MCP)** template. Copy it, it is shown only once. This flow uses the scope messages:send.
3. **Paste it here.** Double-click a whatsapp node of this flow, click the pencil next to **Account**, paste the key and press **Test**. It tells you whether the key works and whether your number is linked.

**About this flow.** Replace +12025550123 with the number that should receive the message. Replace the two inject nodes with your sensor (MQTT, Zigbee, Modbus or any node that emits the temperature in msg.payload). Open the function node to set the limit (30) and the value that counts as back to normal (28). The gap stops a reading that bounces around the limit from sending many messages.

name: above the limit or back to normal?
